theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.BackwardAudit.basepoint_refl_concreteSpan_iff
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {G : MCore.GradedRationalHodgeData} {M : MCore.CycleSpanMechanics G} {X : G.Variety} {p : Nat}   {α : G.CohomologyQ X (2 * p)} {hX : G.isSmoothProjective X} {hα : G.isTypePP p α}   (S : MCore.BackwardAudit.SpreadData G X p α hX hα),   MCore.InConcreteCycleSpan M       (MCore.BackwardAudit.TypedVariationalGeometry.transportedAlpha S (S.pathRefl S.basepoint)) ↔     MCore.InConcreteCycleSpan M α

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.BackwardAudit.castCycleCombination_eval
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {G : MCore.GradedRationalHodgeData} {M : MCore.CycleSpanMechanics G} {X Y : G.Variety} {p : Nat} (h : X = Y)   (C : MCore.CycleCombination G M X p),   MCore.CycleCombination.eval M (MCore.BackwardAudit.castCycleCombination h C) =     MCore.BackwardAudit.castCohomology G h (MCore.CycleCombination.eval M C)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.BackwardAudit.concreteSpan_cast_iff
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {G : MCore.GradedRationalHodgeData} {M : MCore.CycleSpanMechanics G} {X Y : G.Variety} {p : Nat} (h : X = Y)   (β : G.CohomologyQ X (2 * p)),   MCore.InConcreteCycleSpan M (MCore.BackwardAudit.castCohomology G h β) ↔ MCore.InConcreteCycleSpan M β
